reader_summary.headline: As we enter a new era of distributed computing -- and of big data.
reader_summary.overview: As we enter a new era of distributed computing -- and of big data, in the form of machine and deep learning -- storage becomes (even more) important. It might not be sexy, but storage is what makes the internet and cloud computing go round and round: "Without storage, we wouldn't have databases. we wouldn't have anything because information needs to be stored.
